name: Corner Woodworks
old_description: Welcome to the home of Corner Woodworks! We build to order, build to suit, and also design in collaboration with you for your space. For our furniture, custom cabinets, and wood countertops we use genuine solid hardwoods combined with modern day joinery and silky smooth hand rubbed finishes that we guarantee to bead water.
about:
Corner Woodworks operates from Manchester, Maryland, where it designs and builds custom wood products for residential and commercial clients. The shop focuses on made-to-order furniture, cabinetry, and countertops using solid hardwoods.

The company produces custom furniture, cabinets, wood countertops, millwork, and butcher block countertops. Each piece is crafted with modern joinery techniques and finished with hand-rubbed oils that penetrate the wood rather than forming a surface film. The shop avoids veneers over fiberboard, using solid hardwood throughout.

Clients engage the shop for collaborative design services, whether for a single piece of furniture or a full kitchen installation. The business serves homeowners, designers, and contractors seeking tailored woodwork built to specific dimensions and aesthetic requirements.

Corner Woodworks differentiates itself through its finishing process, which it says creates a flexible, durable surface that beads water and accentuates the natural character of the wood. The company also emphasizes that all products are manufactured in the United States.
